                    sorted([p for p in parts if p[1] > 0], key=lambda p: p[1])):"""

    pos = [p for p in parts if p[1] > 0]
    deg = {}
    for (v, _rv) in pos:
        tot = 0
        for l, (a, b) in enumerate(links):
            if a == v or b == v:
                tot += caps[l]
        deg[v] = tot
    orders = [
        sorted(pos, key=lambda p: -p[1]),
        sorted(pos, key=lambda p: p[1]),
        sorted(pos, key=lambda p: (deg[p[0]], -p[1])),
        sorted(pos, key=lambda p: (-deg[p[0]], -p[1])),
    ]
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for o in orders:
        key = tuple(o)
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            out.append(o)
